verticalFaqs.question: Can Duet handle emails with reference photos and design attachments?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Duet sees the full email thread including attachments, so it understands the context when a client sends inspiration photos or design feedback. It won't describe the images back, but it knows a client just sent reference photos and drafts an appropriate reply — confirming receipt, asking clarifying questions about the design, or providing next steps based on your usual workflow.

verticalFaqs.question: My custom projects have long email threads with 10+ messages. Can Duet follow those?
verticalFaqs.answer: That's exactly where Duet shines. It reads the entire thread history — consultation notes, design revisions, material choices, timeline updates — so every drafted reply has full context. When a client asks 'what's the status of my ring?' in email #14, Duet knows which ring, what stage it's in, and drafts an accurate update. No more re-reading 3 months of emails yourself.
